meta.notice: Design configuration only. Market data, regulations, payment availability, prices and product facts require local legal, tax and supplier verification before launch. No live integration or real product record is asserted.
meta.productDataPolicy: No product facts, prices, barcodes, awards or image URLs are generated.

scope.canonicalRelationship: Catalogue/expansion domain inside Vintora Market; not an eleventh product module and not a canonical launch phase.

complianceChecklist: KYC where required by jurisdiction or order value

validationRules.description: Country must have an ISO alpha-2 code, currency and at least one configured language.
Every product template must expose all requested listing fields.
Candidate brand names are not verified brands until identity and rights evidence is attached.
Prices, barcodes, awards, ABV, bottle size and official URLs must come from a verified source.
Official and lifestyle images require a licensed or authorised asset record.
Availability must be evaluated per target market; absence of evidence is unverified, not available.
Regional tax calculations must reference a reviewed tax rule and currency.
Distributor records require KYC, licence evidence and brand authorisation before activation.
Payment gateways are candidate adapters until credentials and legal review are recorded.
Product publication requires human approval after compliance and asset moderation.
AI recommendation and SEO fields must be labelled derived when generated by rules.
Audit records are append-only for brands, products, prices and approvals.
